principle: Arm A is the project's documentation at the frame end: the last default-branch commit at or before 2026-09-30T23:59:59Z (snapshots in current-doc-check.json). A candidate whose rule is not stated in that snapshot is excluded, whether its change added or removed the text. Otherwise keep the frozen mechanism's rule (first admitting vote) unless it fails V2 (only the presence, label or location of a control). Keeping the frozen rule keeps it aligned with the probe. Where a frozen rule is kept but its observation is only the presence of a setting, the oracle must test the setting's effect (oracle_requirement).
